/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ti.title: Time and Space Complexity
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ti.description: Understanding how algorithm performance is measured using Big-O notation and analyzing time-space tradeoffs.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ar.title: Arrays
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ar.description: Arrays are one of the most fundamental data structures in computer science. They provide a way to store elements in a contiguous block of memory, allowing efficient access and manipulation.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: Strings
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: Strings are fundamental data types serving as the foundation for text processing, pattern recognition, and encoding/decoding operations.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.title: Bit Manipulation
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.description: Bit manipulation (bit wise) is one of the most powerful tools in computer science, allowing direct control over how data is represented and processed at the hardware level.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ha.title: Hashtable
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ha.description: A hash table is a data structure that stores key-value pairs and allows extremely fast lookups, insertions, and deletions, typically in O(1) average time.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tw.title: Two Pointers
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tw.description: The Two Pointers technique uses two indices to solve array problems in linear time O(n) instead of inefficient O(n²) nested loops.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/pr.title: Prefix Sum
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/pr.description: The Prefix Sum technique precomputes cumulative information so that range sum queries can be answered in O(1) time.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/sl.title: Sliding Window
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/sl.description: The Sliding Window pattern transforms O(n²) problems into O(n) solutions by maintaining a window over data and adjusting it incrementally.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ka.title: Kadane's Algorithm
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ka.description: Kadane's Algorithm is a classic algorithm designed to efficiently find the maximum sum subarray within a one-dimensional array of numbers in O(n) time.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Matrix (2D Array)
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Matrix problems focus on navigating rows and columns, managing boundaries, applying consistent traversal rules, and performing transformations on 2D arrays.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/li.title: Linked List
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/li.description: A linked list is a data structure consisting of nodes where each node contains a value and a reference to the next node, enabling flexible insertions and deletions.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: Stack
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: A stack is a fundamental LIFO (Last In, First Out) data structure where the last element added is the first one to be removed.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/qu.title: Queue
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/qu.description: A queue is a fundamental FIFO (First In, First Out) data structure where the first element added is the first one to be removed.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bu.title: Bucket sort
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bu.description: Bucket Sort is a distribution-based sorting algorithm that works by dividing elements into several buckets and then sorting each bucket individually. It is particularly effective for sorting numbers that fall within a bounded range or when sorting elements based on their frequency.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/re.title: Recursion
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/re.description: A deep dive into recursion as a problem-solving technique, with practical TypeScript examples.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/me.title: Merge Sort
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/me.description: A deep dive into Merge Sort as a divide-and-conquer algorithm, from array sorting to linked lists and advanced counting problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/qu.title: Quick Sort
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/qu.description: An in-depth look at Quick Sort as a divide-and-conquer algorithm, focusing on partitioning, expected complexity, and selection problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.title: Binary Search
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.description: Binary search is an efficient algorithm for finding an item from a sorted list of items. It works by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ba.title: Backtracking
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ba.description: Deep dive into the backtracking technique, a fundamental approach for combinatorial problems, permutation generation, and constraint satisfaction tasks.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tr.title: Tree
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tr.description: A comprehensive guide to tree, including traversal techniques covering BFS (level-order) and DFS (pre-order, in-order, post-order) with formal tree definitions, tree types, traversal templates, problem patterns, and complexity analysis.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.title: Binary Search Tree and Ordered Set
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.description: Deep dive into Binary Search Trees, Ordered Sets, and their applications in advanced algorithmic problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tr.title: Tries
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tr.description: A comprehensive guide to Trie data structures, exploring their implementation, applications, and use cases.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/he.title: Heaps
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/he.description: A heap is a complete binary tree stored as an array that enforces a priority ordering, enabling O(log n) insert and extract operations and powering greedy scheduling and two-heaps patterns.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/in.title: Intervals
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/in.description: Interval merging, scheduling, and overlap problems. Techniques for efficiently handling ranges, detecting conflicts, and optimizing interval-based tasks.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/k-.title: K-Way Merge
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/k-.description: Learn how to efficiently merge multiple sorted data sources using heaps, a fundamental pattern behind many advanced problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/da.title: Data Structure Design
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/da.description: Data structure design is the art of composing primitive structures into custom abstractions that satisfy complex operational requirements under strict time and space constraints.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/gr.title: Greedy Algorithms
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/gr.description: Greedy algorithms build solutions incrementally by making locally optimal choices at each step, relying on the greedy-choice property and optimal substructure to guarantee global optimality.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/gr.title: Graph
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/gr.description: A comprehensive guide to graph, including traversal using Depth-First Search and Breadth-First Search, extending tree traversal techniques to general graphs with cycles, disconnected components, and implicit structures.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/to.title: Topological Sort
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/to.description: A comprehensive guide to topological sorting on directed acyclic graphs, covering DFS-based and BFS-based approaches, cycle detection, and multi-level dependency resolution.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/un.title: Union Find
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/un.description: A comprehensive guide to the Union Find (Disjoint Set Union) data structure, covering the forest representation, path compression, union by rank, inverse Ackermann analysis, and application patterns for dynamic connectivity problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/mi.title: Minimum Spanning Tree
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/mi.description: A comprehensive guide to Minimum Spanning Trees, covering the cut property, Kruskal's algorithm with Union-Find, Prim's algorithm with a min-heap, and the trade-offs between the two approaches.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/sh.title: Shortest Path
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/sh.description: A comprehensive guide to shortest path algorithms, covering Dijkstra's algorithm with a min-heap, the Bellman-Ford algorithm for graphs with negative weights, and their variations on grids and constrained problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/eu.title: Eulerian Circuit
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/eu.description: A comprehensive guide to Eulerian circuits and paths, covering the necessary and sufficient conditions for their existence, Hierholzer's algorithm, De Bruijn sequences, and applications to graph traversal problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/dp.title: DP Foundations & 1D DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/dp.description: A comprehensive guide to dynamic programming: optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization vs tabulation, state definition, recurrence relations, and space optimization, taught through one-dimensional DP problems.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/kn.title: Knapsack DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/kn.description: A comprehensive guide to knapsack dynamic programming: the 0/1 knapsack pattern for bounded items and the unbounded knapsack pattern for unlimited items, with the critical inner loop direction insight that distinguishes them.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/lo.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/lo.description: A comprehensive guide to the Longest Increasing Subsequence problem: the O(n²) DP formulation, the O(n log n) patience sorting optimization, counting and reconstruction variants, and the unifying view through Dilworth's theorem.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/2d.title: 2D Grid DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/2d.description: A comprehensive guide to dynamic programming on two-dimensional grids: path counting, minimum and maximum path sums, obstacle variants, matrix-local recurrences, transition optimization, multi-dimensional grid states, and rolling-array space reduction.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: String DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: A complete guide to dynamic programming over strings: the two-index prefix table, two-sequence alignment with longest common subsequence, edit distance, distinct subsequences and interleaving, palindromic substructure over intervals, segmentation and decoding of a single string, wildcard pattern matching, and rolling-row space optimization.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: State Machine DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: A guide to dynamic programming over finite automata: states as qualitative modes rather than positions, transitions weighted by gains and costs, the whole stock trading family from one transaction to k transactions with cooldowns and fees, the collapse into rolling scalars, and the layered DAG longest path view.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tr.title: Tree & Graph DP
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/tr.description: Dynamic programming on trees and graphs: post-order DP on rooted trees, states made of a node plus a mode, recurrences that build structures instead of values, rerooting with two traversals, and DP over the DAG induced by a shortest-path algorithm.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ad.title: Advanced DP Techniques
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ad.description: Advanced state modelling in dynamic programming: bitmask DP encoding a set as an integer, digit DP walking the decimal representation of a bound, and probability DP where the value of a state is a probability or an expectation.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: String Matching
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: A rigorous treatment of exact string matching, covering the naive scan, borders and the Knuth-Morris-Pratt prefix function, the pattern-separator-text concatenation, the Rabin-Karp polynomial rolling hash, and binary search on the answer length.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.title: Binary Indexed Tree / Segment Tree
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.description: A comprehensive guide to the two classical structures for dynamic range queries: the segment tree, in its recursive and iterative bottom-up form, and the Fenwick tree, with its lowest-set-bit decomposition, coordinate compression and inversion counting.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Maths / Geometry

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: Repeated String Match
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: Find the minimum number of times a string must be repeated so that another string becomes one of its substrings.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.title: Shortest Palindrome
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/st.description: Build the shortest palindrome obtainable by adding characters only in front of a string, using the KMP failure function over the string concatenated with its reverse.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.description: For every element of an array, count how many elements to its right are strictly smaller, using a Fenwick tree over compressed values.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.title: Range Sum Query - Mutable
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/bi.description: Answer range sum queries on an array whose elements can be updated at any time, keeping both operations logarithmic.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Factorial Trailing Zeroes
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Count the trailing zeroes of n factorial by counting how many times five divides it, using Legendre's formula instead of computing the factorial.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Max Points on a Line
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Find the largest number of points lying on a single straight line by anchoring each point and hashing the reduced direction to every other point.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Minimum Area Rectangle II
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Find the smallest area rectangle with vertices among a set of points, allowing any orientation, by grouping segments that share a midpoint and a length.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Palindrome Number
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Decide whether an integer reads the same forwards and backwards, without converting it to a string, by reversing only half of its digits.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Reverse Integer
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Reverse the decimal digits of a signed integer and return zero when the result falls outside the signed 32 bit range.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.title: Valid Square
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/ma.description: Decide whether four points in the plane form a square by inspecting the multiset of their six pairwise squared distances.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/li.title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/li.description: For each query point, find the size of the smallest interval that contains it, sweeping intervals and queries together in increasing coordinate order.

/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/li.title: The Skyline Problem
/data-structures-and-algorithms/topic/li.description: Compute the upper envelope of a set of rectangular buildings, emitting a key point wherever the visible height changes, with a sweep line and a max-heap of live buildings.
